tool_input.command: cat .eslintrc.cjs | head -80; echo ----; grep -rl "useNotifications" src/features/ | grep "/api/" ; echo "exit $?"
tool_input.description: Read ESLint config and search notification use in api

result:
The comment edit feature is in place in `apps/react-vite`. I didn't run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked, so everything below is checked by reading only.

- **API:** `src/features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` adds a zod schema (`body` required), `updateComment` calling `PATCH /comments/{commentId}`, and `useUpdateComment`. On success it invalidates the comments list and shows a "Comment Updated" notification.
- **Permission:** `src/lib/authorization.tsx` adds a `comment:update` policy that is true only when `comment.author.id` matches the current user. Admins can delete other people's comments but cannot edit them, since the request was for the author only.
- **UI:** `src/features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` is an Edit button that opens a form drawer prefilled with the comment body. `comments-list.tsx` renders it only when the policy passes, next to the existing Delete button.
- **Mock backend:** `src/testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` adds a PATCH handler. It returns 404 for an unknown comment, 403 when the requester is not the author, and otherwise updates the body and persists it.

Decisions for you to check:
- The success notification is in the hook under `api/`, not in the component. I followed the feature CLAUDE.md. The existing Create and Delete components still put notifications in the component, so this is inconsistent with them.
- The CLAUDE.md says this is enforced by `no-restricted-imports`, but `.eslintrc.cjs` has no such rule. I did not add one.
- I did not add tests for the new endpoint or component.

Nothing is committed.
